name: Baron Longshore's Head
summary: Along the Merchant Coast, Baron Longshore's Head proves the pirate captain is dead. Gazlowe offers a bounty for identifiable remains to protect Ratchet's commercial shipping.

sections.title: A Price on a Buccaneer
sections.body: From camps along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet, Baron Longshore led Southsea Freebooter raids. His flagship, the Heedless, threatened goblin trade lanes between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. So Gazlowe, Ratchet's Chief Engineer, offered a bounty for proof of Longshore's death. The port authority pays a monetary reward when the pirate's head is delivered.

faq.answer: Baron Longshore was a pirate captain from the human kingdom of Gilneas. From camps along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet, he led Southsea Freebooters and terrorized shipping lanes aboard the Heedless.

Gazlowe, Ratchet's goblin leader, posted a public bounty for Baron Longshore's identifiable remains. The Southsea Freebooters preyed on Ratchet's merchant vessels, and Gazlowe wanted the harbor's trade to remain uninterrupted.
Baron Longshore patrols three Southsea pirate encampments on the coastline south of Ratchet, just north of Northwatch Hold along the Merchant Coast.

faq.q: What ship did Baron Longshore command?
faq.answer: Baron Longshore captained the Heedless, which raided merchant ships on the Great Sea off the Barrens coast.

angles.text: As a human, you can trace Baron Longshore's origins to Gilneas, the isolationist nation he left before joining the Southsea Freebooters.
